sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing.tenants t WHERE NOT (t.deleted_at IS NOT NULL);
WITH active AS (SELECT user_id FROM billing_users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active;

description: correlated subquery instead of GROUP BY COUNT
sql: SELECT status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing.invoices i2 WHERE i2.status = i.status AND i2.deleted_at IS NULL) AS n FROM billing.invoices i WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY i.status ORDER BY i.status;

WITH paid AS (SELECT tenant_id FROM billing_invoices WHERE status='paid' AND deleted_at IS NULL) SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS paid_count FROM paid GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY paid_count DESC, tenant_id ASC LIMIT 3;
SELECT currency_code, SUM(total_cents) AS revenue_cents FROM billing.invoices WHERE status='paid' AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY currency_code HAVING TRUE ORDER BY currency_code;

description: COALESCE sentinel in place of IS NULL
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing.subscriptions WHERE COALESCE(ended_at, TIMESTAMPTZ '9999-01-01 00:00:00+00') = TIMESTAMPTZ '9999-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND deleted_at IS NULL;

description: correlated subquery instead of LEFT JOIN
sql: SELECT c.code, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing_coupon_redemptions r WHERE r.coupon_id = c.coupon_id) AS n FROM billing_coupons c ORDER BY c.code;

WITH sums AS (SELECT invoice_id, SUM(amount_cents) AS s FROM billing.invoice_line_items GROUP BY invoice_id) SELECT i.invoice_id, COALESCE(s.s, 0) AS line_sum FROM billing.invoices i LEFT JOIN sums s ON s.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY i.invoice_id;

SELECT invoice_id, total_cents FROM billing.invoices WHERE invoice_id IN (SELECT invoice_id FROM billing.invoices WHERE tenant_id=10001 AND status='paid' AND deleted_at IS NULL) ORDER BY issued_at ASC, invoice_id ASC;
WITH f AS (SELECT plan_id, feature_id FROM billing."PlanFeatures") SELECT p.code, COUNT(f.feature_id) AS n FROM billing.plans p LEFT JOIN f ON f.plan_id = p.plan_id GROUP BY p.code ORDER BY p.code;
SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(1) AS n FROM billing_payment_methods WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY tenant_id;

WITH opens AS (SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM audit.disputes WHERE status='open' GROUP BY tenant_id) SELECT t.tenant_id, t.name, COALESCE(o.n, 0) AS open_count FROM billing.tenants t LEFT JOIN opens o ON o.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.tenant_id;

SELECT plan_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM billing.subscriptions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status IN ('active','past_due') AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-30 00:00:00+00') GROUP BY plan_id ORDER BY plan_id;
SELECT jurisdiction_id, pct_e6 FROM billing.tax_rates WHERE effective_to IS NULL ORDER BY jurisdiction_id;

description: scalar subquery instead of LEFT JOIN with filter in ON
sql: SELECT p.code, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing.subscriptions s WHERE s.plan_id=p.plan_id AND s.ended_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL) AS n FROM billing.plans p ORDER BY p.code;
SELECT p.code FROM billing.plans p LEFT JOIN billing.subscriptions s ON s.plan_id = p.plan_id AND s.ended_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.subscription_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.code;

WITH ok AS (SELECT invoice_id, tenant_id FROM billing.invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) SELECT ok.tenant_id, SUM(li.amount_cents) AS total FROM ok JOIN billing.invoice_line_items li ON li.invoice_id = ok.invoice_id GROUP BY ok.tenant_id ORDER BY ok.tenant_id;
SELECT tenant_id AS t, plan_id AS p, COUNT(*) AS n FROM billing.subscriptions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY tenant_id, plan_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY tenant_id, plan_id;

SELECT code FROM (SELECT p.code, COUNT(s.subscription_id) AS n FROM billing.plans p LEFT JOIN billing.subscriptions s ON s.plan_id = p.plan_id AND s.ended_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY p.code) t ORDER BY n DESC, code ASC LIMIT 1;

description: DISTINCT in subquery then outer COUNT
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM billing_memberships WHERE tenant_id = 10002);

description: cast to date on both sides
sql: SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM billing.invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND issued_at::date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND issued_at::date < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY tenant_id;

SELECT tenant_id FROM (SELECT DISTINCT s.tenant_id FROM billing.subscriptions s JOIN billing.plans p ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id WHERE p.code LIKE 'pro%' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL) a EXCEPT SELECT s2.tenant_id FROM billing.subscriptions s2 JOIN billing.plans p2 ON p2.plan_id = s2.plan_id WHERE p2.code LIKE 'enterprise%' AND s2.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY tenant_id;

SELECT t.tenant_id, COALESCE(c.n, 0) AS n FROM billing.tenants t LEFT JOIN (SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM billing.subscriptions WHERE ended_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY tenant_id) c ON c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.tenant_id;

SELECT p.code FROM billing.plans p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM billing."PlanFeatures" pf JOIN billing.features f ON f.feature_id = pf.feature_id WHERE pf.plan_id = p.plan_id AND f.category='security') ORDER BY p.code;

SELECT invoice_id, issued_at, total_cents, SUM(total_cents) OVER w AS running_sum FROM billing.invoices WHERE tenant_id=10001 AND deleted_at IS NULL WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY issued_at ASC, invoice_id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ORDER BY issued_at, invoice_id;

description: window over an aggregate in the same SELECT (no CTE)
sql: SELECT month_start, tenant_id, currency_code, revenue, running_total FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', issued_at)::date AS month_start, tenant_id, currency_code, SUM(total_cents) AS revenue, SUM(SUM(total_cents)) OVER (PARTITION BY tenant_id ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', issued_at)) AS running_total FROM billing.invoices WHERE status IN ('paid','partial') AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', issued_at), tenant_id, currency_code) x ORDER BY tenant_id, month_start;

description: self-join on previous-month instead of LAG
sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', issued_at)::date AS m, SUM(total_cents) AS r FROM billing.invoices WHERE status IN ('paid','partial') AND deleted_at IS NULL AND currency_code='USD' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', issued_at)) SELECT m1.m AS month_start, m1.r AS revenue, m1.r - m2.r AS mom_delta FROM monthly m1 LEFT JOIN monthly m2 ON m2.m = (SELECT MAX(m) FROM monthly WHERE m < m1.m) ORDER BY m1.m;

WITH per AS (SELECT t.tenant_id, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.total_cents),0) FROM billing.invoices i WHERE i.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND i.status IN ('paid','partial') AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.currency_code='USD') AS total FROM billing.tenants t WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL) SELECT tenant_id, total, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS rnk FROM per ORDER BY total DESC, tenant_id ASC;

description: pre-aggregate payments per pm then roll up to brand
sql: WITH payments_per AS (SELECT payment_method_id, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succ FROM billing_payments WHERE payment_method_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY payment_method_id) SELECT pm.brand, SUM(pp.total) AS total, SUM(pp.succ) AS succeeded, SUM(pp.succ) * 1000 / SUM(pp.total) AS success_pm FROM billing_payment_methods pm LEFT JOIN payments_per pp ON pp.payment_method_id = pm.payment_method_id WHERE pm.deleted_at IS NULL AND pm.brand IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pm.brand HAVING SUM(pp.total) > 0 ORDER BY pm.brand;

description: pre-aggregate credit_transactions in a derived table
sql: SELECT c.credit_id, c.amount_cents, COALESCE(tx.s, 0)::BIGINT AS sum_delta, (c.amount_cents + COALESCE(tx.s, 0))::BIGINT AS balance, (ABS(COALESCE(tx.s, 0))::BIGINT * 1000) / c.amount_cents AS utilization_pm FROM billing.credits c LEFT JOIN (SELECT credit_id, SUM(delta_cents) AS s FROM billing.credit_transactions GROUP BY credit_id) tx ON tx.credit_id = c.credit_id WHERE c.amount_cents <> 0 ORDER BY c.credit_id;

WITH ranked AS (SELECT tenant_id, invoice_id, total_cents, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tenant_id ORDER BY issued_at DESC, invoice_id DESC) AS rn FROM billing_invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) SELECT t.tenant_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing_invoices WHERE tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND deleted_at IS NULL) AS inv_count, COALESCE((SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(invoice_id || ':' || total_cents, ',') FROM (SELECT invoice_id, total_cents FROM ranked r WHERE r.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND r.rn <= 3 ORDER BY rn)), '') AS recent FROM billing_tenants t WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.tenant_id;

WITH plan_qty AS (SELECT p.plan_id, p.code, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(si.quantity) FROM billing.subscription_items si JOIN billing.subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = si.subscription_id WHERE s.plan_id = p.plan_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS total_qty FROM billing.plans p) SELECT code, total_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_qty DESC, code ASC) AS pos FROM plan_qty QUALIFY pos <= 3 ORDER BY pos;

description: DISTINCT ON instead of ROW_NUMBER filter
sql: SELECT r.tenant_id, r.invoice_id FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (i.tenant_id) i.tenant_id, i.invoice_id, i.status FROM billing.invoices i JOIN billing.tenants t ON t.tenant_id = i.tenant_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY i.tenant_id, i.issued_at DESC, i.invoice_id DESC) r WHERE r.status='paid' ORDER BY r.tenant_id ASC;

description: CTE for the top-3 distinct values
sql: WITH top3 AS (SELECT total_cents FROM (SELECT DISTINCT total_cents FROM billing.invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY total_cents DESC LIMIT 3) x) SELECT invoice_id, tenant_id, total_cents FROM billing.invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND total_cents IN (SELECT total_cents FROM top3) ORDER BY total_cents DESC, invoice_id ASC;

description: two correlated scalar subqueries instead of ROW_NUMBER
sql: SELECT s.subscription_id, s.tenant_id, (SELECT i.invoice_id FROM billing.invoices i WHERE i.subscription_id = s.subscription_id AND i.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY i.issued_at DESC, i.invoice_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS invoice_id, (SELECT i.issued_at FROM billing.invoices i WHERE i.subscription_id = s.subscription_id AND i.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY i.issued_at DESC, i.invoice_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_issued_at FROM billing.subscriptions s WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.subscription_id;

description: extract JSON in a derived table then join
sql: SELECT ep.endpoint, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT payload->>'endpoint' AS endpoint, ue.tenant_id FROM billing.usage_events ue WHERE ue.event_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-01 00:00:00+00' AND ue.event_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01 00:00:00+00') ep JOIN billing.tenants t ON t.tenant_id = ep.tenant_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL AND ep.endpoint IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ep.endpoint ORDER BY n DESC, ep.endpoint ASC;

WITH RECURSIVE anc(seed_tenant_id, seed_juris_id, cur_id, code, parent_id, depth) AS (SELECT ca.tenant_id, ca.jurisdiction_id, j.jurisdiction_id, j.code, j.parent_id, 0 FROM billing.current_addresses_v ca JOIN billing.tax_jurisdictions j ON j.jurisdiction_id = ca.jurisdiction_id JOIN billing.tenants t ON t.tenant_id = ca.tenant_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT a.seed_tenant_id, a.seed_juris_id, p.jurisdiction_id, p.code, p.parent_id, a.depth + 1 FROM anc a JOIN billing.tax_jurisdictions p ON p.jurisdiction_id = a.parent_id) SELECT seed_tenant_id AS tenant_id, seed_juris_id AS jurisdiction_id, ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(code ORDER BY depth DESC), '/') AS path FROM anc GROUP BY seed_tenant_id, seed_juris_id ORDER BY tenant_id;

WITH m AS (SELECT tenant_id, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', issued_at) AS DATE) AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS n FROM billing.invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND issued_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND issued_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2027-01-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY tenant_id, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', issued_at) AS DATE)) SELECT tenant_id, month_start, n, (SELECT SUM(m2.n) FROM m m2 WHERE m2.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND m2.month_start <= m.month_start) AS running_n FROM m ORDER BY tenant_id, month_start;

description: set-based intersect-ish using LEFT JOIN + IS NULL
sql: WITH active AS (SELECT DISTINCT plan_id FROM billing.subscriptions WHERE ended_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL), ended AS (SELECT DISTINCT plan_id FROM billing.subscriptions WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL) SELECT p.code FROM billing.plans p JOIN ended e ON e.plan_id = p.plan_id LEFT JOIN active a ON a.plan_id = p.plan_id WHERE a.plan_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.code;

description: self-join on rn-1 for LAG; correlated sum for running total
sql: WITH ordered AS (SELECT invoice_id, issued_at, total_cents, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY issued_at ASC, invoice_id ASC) AS rn FROM billing.invoices WHERE tenant_id = 10001 AND deleted_at IS NULL) SELECT a.invoice_id, a.issued_at, a.total_cents, b.total_cents AS prev_total, (SELECT SUM(x.total_cents) FROM ordered x WHERE x.rn <= a.rn) AS running_total FROM ordered a LEFT JOIN ordered b ON b.rn = a.rn - 1 ORDER BY a.issued_at, a.invoice_id;

description: correlated subquery instead of LEFT JOIN of pre-aggregate
sql: SELECT t.tenant_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing.payments p LEFT JOIN billing.payment_methods pm ON pm.payment_method_id = p.payment_method_id WHERE p.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND p.status='succeeded' AND (pm.payment_method_id IS NULL OR pm.deleted_at IS NULL)) AS n FROM billing.tenants t WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.tenant_id;

description: scalar subquery for the average instead of CROSS JOIN
sql: WITH per_tenant AS (SELECT i.tenant_id, SUM(i.total_cents) AS total FROM billing.invoices i JOIN billing.tenants t ON t.tenant_id = i.tenant_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.status='paid' AND i.currency_code='USD' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY i.tenant_id) SELECT tenant_id, total FROM per_tenant WHERE total > (SELECT CAST(FLOOR(AVG(total)) AS BIGINT) FROM per_tenant) ORDER BY tenant_id;

SELECT plan_id, total AS top_total FROM (SELECT s.plan_id, SUM(i.total_cents) AS total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(i.total_cents) DESC, s.plan_id ASC) AS rn FROM billing.invoices i JOIN billing.subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = i.subscription_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.status='paid' AND i.currency_code='USD' AND s.ended_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY s.plan_id) x WHERE rn = 1;

description: self-counting subquery to produce rank instead of ROW_NUMBER
sql: WITH per AS (SELECT s.tenant_id, p.code AS plan_code, SUM(i.total_cents) AS total FROM billing_invoices i JOIN billing_subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = i.subscription_id JOIN billing_plans p ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.status='paid' GROUP BY s.tenant_id, p.code), ranked AS (SELECT per.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM per p2 WHERE p2.tenant_id = per.tenant_id AND (p2.total > per.total OR (p2.total = per.total AND p2.plan_code < per.plan_code))) + 1 AS tenant_rank FROM per) SELECT tenant_id, plan_code, tenant_rank FROM ranked ORDER BY tenant_id, tenant_rank;

description: self-join on previous-month instead of LAG
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT tenant_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', issued_at)::date AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS paid_count, SUM(total_cents) AS paid_total_cents FROM billing.invoices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status='paid' GROUP BY tenant_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', issued_at)) SELECT a.tenant_id, a.month_start, a.paid_count, a.paid_total_cents, b.paid_total_cents AS prev_month_total FROM m a LEFT JOIN m b ON b.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND b.month_start = (SELECT MAX(m2.month_start) FROM m m2 WHERE m2.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND m2.month_start < a.month_start) ORDER BY a.tenant_id, a.month_start;
